Uddhav Thackeray addresses youth rally post Dharmendra Pradhan resignation

Former Maharashtra Chief Minister Uddhav Thackeray addressed a 'Tiranga Vijay Rally' in Mumbai following the resignation of Union Minister Dharmendra Pradhan. Thackeray stated that votes can be stolen, but not people, framing the event as a victory for patriots over "blind devotees." He also referred to the youth as "avatars of Vishnu." Raj Thackeray praised the strength of Gen-Z. The rally was attended by a large number of young people celebrating Pradhan's resignation.
